title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs
description: A look at the use of dogs' natural instinct to love, nurture and protect, including a blind Philadelphia woman who has found a new lease of life thanks to her new running mate and a Jack Russell caring for a surprising array of species in Namibia.

title: Reef Wrecks
description: An exploration of the shipwrecks off the coast of the Florida Keys, where an estimated 1,000 sea vessels remain underwater.

title: Animals Like Us
description: Everyone helps with the upbringing of the little lion cubs in Kenya. Plus, a group of bees start a dance party.

description: Jess and Dan grab a smelly snake before Stu rescues one at university.

title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit
description: Mick and Adele separate mating eastern browns, while Stu and Liv search a warehouse as danger mounts.

title: Great Lakes Wild
description: The Lake Erie watersnake is currently on the brink of extinction and researchers are fighting to get it back. Thanks to the round goby, it is working.

title: Great Lakes Wild
description: It is a conundrum of conservation. Where animals and humans co-exist, how do you stop a bad reputation from pushing a species towards extinction?

title: Planet Weird
description: Cameras journey with nature's nomads and hitchhikers, from monarch butterflies on an epic migration to the hidden world within a sloth's fur.

title: Big Cats, Nine Lives
description: Following a tiger from tiny cub to formidable hunter, as instinct and stealth guide it through a solitary world of shifting territories, fierce rivalry and ever-present danger.

title: Monkeys: An Amazing Animal Family
description: Biologist Patrick Aryee reveals the stories behind the origins of each of the world's primate species, coming face-to-face with some of the planet's most charismatic and mischievous monkeys. He begins his journey in Asia.

title: Monkeys: An Amazing Animal Family
description: Biologist Patrick Aryee takes a closer look at the rise of the monkey, exploring the many diverse species and their place in primate evolution.

title: Monkeys: An Amazing Animal Family
description: Biologist Patrick Aryee examines the development of monkeys from Central and South America and their evolutionary journey dating back more than 40 million years.

title: David Attenborough's Kingdom of Plants
description: The naturalist and film-maker explores the many varieties of plant life housed at the Royal Botanic Gardens in Kew, west London, and explains what they reveal about the natural world and the development of life on Earth. He begins inside the establishment's Palm House, whose climate has been engineered to simulate conditions found in rainforests, charting the evolution of plants that grow in the world's wettest regions and investigating how flowering plants spread across the globe so rapidly.

title: David Attenborough's Kingdom of Plants
description: The naturalist explores how the plants at Kew Gardens change through the seasons and demonstrates the surprising properties of several species, including the predatory pond-dwelling bladderwort utricularia and a fungus that appears to be capable of mind control. He also discusses the largest single organism on the planet, visits the world's biggest flower and explains how plants and insects can communicate using scents and music.

title: David Attenborough's Kingdom of Plants
description: The naturalist concludes his exploration of the Royal Botanic Gardens in Kew, west London, by examining plants that have evolved to minimise their dependence on water, enabling them to survive in the world's driest environments. He witnesses a cactus blooming at midnight, tells the story of the spectacular flowering of the Agave franzosinii, and visits the Millennium Seed Bank, a facility designed to save plants from future extinction.

title: Deadly Australians
description: A peek behind the facade of Australia's dramatic desert scenery, where there lurks a motley crew of silent assassins, con-artists, gang members and brutal brawlers.

title: Shark Squad
description: The work of a team trying to unlock shark secrets in the Bahamas, including their sociability, their bravery and where they give birth. The answers may help protect them.

title: Land of the Far North
description: Life in the Arctic Circle, where the sun hardly sets in summer. Food is abundant, but animals and plants alike face great challenges such as sleep deprivation, pests and predators.

title: Land of the Far North
description: Cold and darkness dominate the Arctic Circle during winter, but nature copes astonishingly well. This documentary reveals how plants and animals survive these brutal conditions.

title: How the Wild Things Sleep
description: The secrets of the most extreme sleepers of the animal kingdom, looking at how they deal with sleep deprivation and trying to discover whether animals dream.

title: Extraordinary Animals
description: Examining some of the oddest Australian animals - including the thorny devil, frogfish, mudskippers and more - and discovering how eccentricity can be a superpower in the wild.

title: City Wildlife Rescue
description: A curious raccoon sticks his head a little too far into a peanut butter jar on a sweltering summer day in Toronto. See how the team gets him out of this sticky situation.

title: City Wildlife Rescue
description: The rescue crew pays a house call to a sleepy horse barn where a fox with an irritating skin condition is staying up in an old stall.

title: Secret Life of the Koala
description: Profile of the eucalyptus-eating, tree-hugging Australian icons. The creatures live in the east and south-east parts of the continent. This episode reveals how their behaviours differ in different regions.

title: Secret Life of the Koala
description: While koalas may seem lazy, their behaviour drastically changes during mating season. As the season of love begins, the documentary follows two males on a mission to mate.

title: New Kids in the Wild
description: Experts test the limits with jaguar cub Frida, as she hones her survival skills in Brazil's Caiman Lodge Reserve.

title: Seasons of the Wild
description: A look at the unique ecosystem of Florida's Everglades, beginning with the season of drought, when conditions bring big changes. With water scarce, predators and prey are pushed dangerously close together.

title: Seasons of the Wild
description: The rainy season in the Florida Everglades, a stark contrast to the dry winter which preceded it, as the 600-plus animal species expand both their hunting and breeding grounds.

title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters
description: This edition unmasks the beauty of swamplands, which have inspired centuries of folklore and serve as a vital link between life and death.

title: Secret World of Sound with David Attenborough
description: The broadcaster explores the ways different creatures hear and produce sound and how it can influence their decisions, using cutting-edge audio technology to reveal a new perspective and understanding of animal behaviour.

title: Secret World of Sound with David Attenborough
description: From melodic songs to strange hums, David Attenborough shares the sounds that gibbons, lyrebirds, bull elk and more use to find a mate - and warn off the competition.

title: Secret World of Sound with David Attenborough
description: A look at how baby animals communicate in their quest for survival, using sound to beg and call for help in the early days of life.

title: Planet Weird
description: Meeting nature's oddballs and mavericks, revealing the bizarre behaviours and ingenious adaptations that help remarkable animals survive.

title: Big Cats, Nine Lives
description: Following leopards through harsh landscapes, where stealth and cunning help them outwit rivals, find food and protect their young against the odds.

title: Impossible Animals
description: The challenges posed by different habitats, beginning with the desert, a world with no water and where temperatures fluctuate from the blistering heat of midday to the freezing depths of night.

title: Impossible Animals
description: The rainforest is the richest habitat on Earth, but still the animals here must develop impressive locomotion, defence and camouflage skills to survive.

description: Patrick Aryee examines the animals that live on the coast. From crashing waves to extreme tides, surviving here takes ingenuity and incredible adaptations.
